title: Users can register with email and password
description:
Add a registration flow that lets new users create accounts using an email and password. The flow stores the user record, hashes the password with bcrypt, and sends a verification email. Failures (duplicate email, weak password, mail-service unavailable) return structured error envelopes.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | New user can register | e2e | playwright spec exercising /register |
| 2 | Duplicate email is rejected | unit | jest test on RegisterService |
| 3 | Weak password is rejected | unit | jest test on PasswordPolicy |
acceptance_criteria:
- New user submits email+password and receives a verification email
- Duplicate email returns 409 with structured error
- Password below policy minimum returns 422 with structured error

metadata.intent: Enable self-service account creation. Scope IN: email/password registration, password hashing, verification mail. Scope OUT: OAuth, password reset, account deletion.
